question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be attained together.
Great accomplishment in both is possible.
Such accomplishment inspires affection from yoginīs.
inference: One possessing great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One who has the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
